name: Hirohito
contribution: Emperor of Japan from 25 December 1926 until his death in 1989.

checks.lead: Hirohito (29 April 1901 – 7 January 1989), also known by his posthumous name Emperor Shōwa, was Emperor of Japan from 25 December 1926 until his death in 1989. He is the longest-reigning emperor in Japanese history as well as one of the world's longest-reigning monarchs. The Shōwa era that corresponded to his reign was initially characterized by heightened  Japanese nationalism and militarism, developments which culminated in Japan's entry into World War II as an Axis power. After Japan's defeat in the war and under pressure from the victorious Allied powers, he renounced his divinity as Emperor via the Humanity Declaration and sanctioned a new Constitution for Japan based on parliamentary government and pacifism.
